{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TOUGHNESS 28-32 HRC"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT
AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block specifies hardness as 28-32 HRC while note N3 specifies 24-32 HRC, creating a conflict about the required heat treatment. This ambiguity can lead to parts being accepted or rejected incorrectly; the designer must align both references to a single hardness range.","recommended_correction":"Update either the title block heat_treatment field or note N3 so that both state the same hardness range."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"-0.013"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH  :  I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N8","page":1,"quote":"M30 x 1.5 x 25 DEEP MAJOR DIA-0.1"}],"comment":"Dimension D24 shows a tolerance band of 0.013 mm on what appears to be a thread feature (per note N8), yet the part is zinc plated per note N2 and there is no allowance for plating thickness on this tight tolerance. Plating buildup will push the finished size out of tolerance, preventing proper thread assembly; the designer must add plating allowance or specify retapping after plating for this specific dimension.","recommended_correction":"Increase the pre-plate tolerance band on D24 to accommodate the zinc plating thickness, or add a note requiring re-machining of this feature after surface treatment."}]}
